Two comfortable bedrooms provide excellent privacy, with two bathrooms adding convenience for residents and guests. Ideally located in a desirable Vancouver neighbourhood, you’ll enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, transit, schools, and everyday amenities.
